text:
Nazem Kadri is back in Colorado, four years after leaving with a Cup ring, and he fits the way he used to. Fifteen points in 19 games, six on the power play, and the Avalanche win the chance battle when he's on (54% of the expected goals at five on five).

His last ten games have been better than the minutes suggest: five goals and nine points while his ice time fell more than three minutes a night. That's a good sign for a 36-year-old, because the shooting isn't hot; he's at 9.8% against a typical range near 10.5. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking likes the details too: clean exits, lots of shot assists and plenty of chances from the slot.

The flaws are still Kadri flaws (the Denver Gazette flagged a turnover of his that led straight to a Chicago goal recently). Our range: 44 to 65 points.
